description: This file contains utility functions for managing UCI configurations and interacting with ubus in the bbf.config daemon, including functions for reloading services, applying changes, and making ubus calls.

methods.name: strncpyt
methods.description: Copies a string with null-termination, ensuring no buffer overflow.

methods.name: bbf_config_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call to invoke a method on a specified object.

methods.name: reload_service
methods.description: Reloads a specific service configuration, either committing or reverting changes.

methods.name: reload_specified_services
methods.description: Reverts or commits changes for a list of services and optionally reloads them.

methods.name: reload_all_services
methods.description: Reverts or commits all UCI configurations and reloads services accordingly.

methods.name: uci_apply_changes
methods.description: Applies (commits or reverts) all UCI configuration changes.

methods.name: uci_config_changes
methods.description: Detects unsaved UCI configuration changes and adds them to a blob buffer.
